findings.message: The source quantifies over every left-and-right Noetherian ring, but `(R : Type)` restricts the formal statement to universe-zero carriers. This is narrower than both the source and the universe-polymorphic `JacobsonConjectureFor`.
findings.suggestion: Change `(R : Type)` to `(R : Type u)`. The resulting universe-polymorphic declaration typechecks.
